description.value: The Blue Ox Pub is a classic neighbourhood pub in Lumby, BC, serving pub food and drinks in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. Open seven days a week, it is a solid stop for touring cyclists passing through the North Okanagan on routes connecting Vernon and the Monashee corridor. The pub hosts regular events and draws a local crowd, giving visiting riders an authentic taste of small-town BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active pub at 1643 Vernon St, Lumby, BC with phone 250-547-2007 and email info@blueoxpub.ca. No bike-specific amenities (racks, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null. The OSM community tag says 'Coldstream' but the website address places the pub in Lumby, BC, which are distinct municipalities — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Coldstream' but the website address is '1643 Vernon St, Lumby, BC, V0E 2G0' — Lumby and Coldstream are separate municipalities; the OSM community assignment appears incorrect.
OSM name is 'Blue Ox Pub' but the website consistently refers to the business as 'The Blue Ox Pub'.
OSM record has no address or phone; all contact details are sourced from the website only.
Menu page returned no item content, so food options (takeout, vegetarian/GF, etc.) could not be assessed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible pub confirmed open via a live website with full contact details — a useful rest stop for touring cyclists in the Lumby area.

wow_evidence: classic neighbourhood pub in Lumby, BC
